svg.title: InsightPilot architecture
svg.desc: Vue connects to FastAPI and separate workbook analysis and document extraction pipelines.

g.text: InsightPilot architecture
Workbook analysis and document extraction in one workspace
Vue 3 frontend
Workspace · Results · Documents · Preferences
FastAPI
Consent gates · session UUIDs · validation · HTTP files and SSE progress
Data Analysis Agent
LangGraph → restricted Pandas child process
Column preview → approval → saved workbook version
Workbook-derived charts, citations and execution traces
Grid, sheet selection, download, refresh and delete
Document Intelligence
PDF / image pages → multimodal classification and fields
Uncertain or failed attempt → one OCR-assisted retry
Azure OCR → Google OCR → vision OCR fallback
Schema checks, conflict review and JSON / XLSX exports
Configured model providers
OpenAI-compatible clients and configured fallback order
Storage and telemetry
Workbook versions, charts, OCR jobs and browser history
